description: Search urlscan.io's public scan database (keyless) for a domain or IP: recent public scans of the site itself (its own pages, not other sites that merely load something from it) with each page's final URL, resolved IP, hosting country/server/ASN, and links to the scan result and its screenshot, plus a roll-up of the related domains urlscan saw serving the pages. Reads urlscan's data, never the target. A caller can pass a raw urlscan field query (e.g. `ip:1.2.3.4`). Read-only.

target.description: Domain to search, e.g. example.com (or a raw urlscan query like ip:1.2.3.4)

name: urlscan_lookup
